snippet.title: Arknights: Endfield Gameplay Preview — Advance and Expand
snippet.description:
We have no other choice now, only to move forward.

▼//Pre-register on our Official Website 

https://endfield.gryphline.com

By reaching the Global Pre-Registration Milestones and meeting the required number of official social media followers, you can receive rewards including the 5★ Operator [Snowshine], [Basic HH Permit] ×20, and the 5★ weapon [Finishing Call]!

#ArknightsEndfield #Endfield #EndfieldBetaTestII
